summary: Clearwater County, Idaho lookout on the Clearwater National Forest: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built 1932, abandoned 1948. Record status 'gone' is not supported by the sources.

facts.design: 40-foot pole L-4 tower with two patrol crow's nest platforms
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1948; no source says whether any of the tower still stands.

evidence.quote: This 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1932, was abandoned in 1948.

evidence.supports: 4 miles east of Pierce (line break before 'Pierce' in the PDF)

evidence.quote: Patrol Points: Two crows nest platforms

evidence.supports: French Mountain summit in Clearwater County, no structure mentioned

corrections.why: All three lookout sources give abandonment in 1948 and none says the tower was removed or destroyed. firelookout.com's heading reads 'R.I.P. 1932-?' with the end year unknown. 'Gone' is not supported; confirm before changing.

notes_for_editor: Status correction is proposed, not applied. Coordinates were checked: Wikipedia gives Pierce, Idaho at 46.4958 N, 115.8011 W, so the record point (46.50337, -115.71711) is about 4 miles east of Pierce, consistent with the sources. Height 12.2 m is converted from '40' pole' and may not be height to the cab floor; flagged. Komoot summit listing is used only to say no structure is mentioned. Its page gives elevation 1,610 m (about 5,282 ft), about 45 ft under the 5,327 ft in firelookout.com and the Forest Service list, so it may be a different point; the story says only 'a French Mountain summit' in Clearwater County and does not claim it is the same point. Forest Service list is a 2016 compilation whose French entry gives Sec33 T37N R6E, 40' pole L-4, 1932, abandoned 1948, 5327 ft. No source describes the site today. Elevation 5327 ft is on firelookout.com and the Forest Service list and is now a facts key (elevation_ft). A second citation was added for the crow's nest platforms.
